message: 肉体を越えるもの

name: Sally
message: 「Alright, does everyone have their Magic Training Casts on?」

name: Synn
message: 「My body feels so heavy...」
Just moving my body slightly sends the sound of creaking metal echoing from head to toe.

name: Misa
message: 「Gravity really is a heavy thing, isn't it...」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh, where's Lolotte-chan?」
A voice comes from down by our feet.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am right here. I cannot move. Everyone, please go ahead with the special training without minding me.」

name: Azel
message: 「Pathetic.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san, please put on a cast as well so that you may understand our suffering.」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse.」

name: Sally
message: 「Okay then, I'm gonna come at you guys seriously and attack like crazy, so block 'em!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? Like this?」

name: Misa
message: 「There's no way we can dodge!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um... This is special training for Spirit Arts, so why are we wearing these casts?」
All of us--excluding Sally-chan and Azel--were fitted from head to toe in suspicious casts.
They were the kind of thing you'd see in an old-school, melodramatic sports manga from two decades ago.

name: Sally
message: 「W-Wait a sec! Where's the cheat sheet I got from BOSS...」

name: Ria
message: 「You have a cheat sheet...\s02」

name: Sally
message: 「Ah, I accidentally left it in the Student Council room!」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, whatever! That's what was written on the regimen BOSS gave me! Even if it doesn't work, it's not my fault.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa. What an irresponsible statement! My guidebook says that whenever someone says something like that, nothing good ever happens.」

name: Misa
message: 「So it actually has some sensible things written in it, huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I think there's a point to this training, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You guys have gotten strong. As the Great Sage, I personally guarantee it. But that's precisely why your current methods are reaching their limit.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah, you're reaching your lim-it!」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Paqy
message: 「In short, you're treating Spirit Arts as an extension of moving your physical bodies. You're trying to control Spirit Arts with your bodies.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You can't master Spirit Arts like that, though.」

name: Sally
message: 「You can't master Spirit Arts like that! Got it?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Being an instructor sure is an easy job.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You guys are subconsciously holding your Spirit Arts back to a level your bodies can control.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Visualization is key to mastering Spirit Arts. That's why restricting your bodies actually removes those physical shackles.」

name: Sally
message: 「I see. So that's how it works. Man, I'm amazing.」

name: Azel
message: 「How foolish.」

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy looking all smart... dreamy.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「So... when blocking an attack, instead of picturing a shield held in my hand, it's more like floating a shield in midair to block it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's my Ria-chan for you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You ruined it at the end, though. Still, I get the gist.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, shall we get started?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaaaah!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why am I caught up in this toooo?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hieeeeee.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am innocent! Aaaaah!」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaaaaaaa!」

name: Sally
message: 「That's all for today!」
One hour later.
Apparently doing it for too long has no effect, so we wrap things up here.
Still, we're completely beat up.
Plus, because we couldn't use the methods we're used to, it feels like we've gotten weaker...

name: Sally
message: 「Hahaha! You're weak, so weak, Student Council!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Grr. Being laughed at by an extra like you is the absolute worst. This is what they call the pot calling the kettle black, isn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, if you use that phrase here, it means we're the kettle too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hau! That was careless of me. To think I'd put myself on the same level as an extra...」

name: Sally
message: 「Hahaha! Same level!」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh? Wait, is that weird?」

name: Misa
message: 「It can't be helped. We couldn't move the way we wanted to.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, everyone managed to block quite a bit toward the end, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Up until now, whenever I defended, I'd thrust my arm out in the direction I pictured a shield, but Spirit Arts actually activate just fine even without doing that.」
The instant Ria-senpai said that, a brightly shining magic circle appeared behind her.

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister has a divine halo shining behind her... How lovely.\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel! Did you get a shot of that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Azel-san isn't here.」

name: Synn
message: 「She was snapping pictures away just a second ago--where could she have gone?」
